camel_example: aliyun resourcemanager AttachPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyType System --ResourceGroupId 'rg-9gLOoK0000' --PolicyName AdministratorAccess --PrincipalName 'alice@demo.onaliyun.com' --PrincipalType IMSUser
description_en: Invokes AttachPolicy to add an access policy to an authorization object (a Resource Access Management (RAM) user, RAM user group, or RAM role), which is authorization. After the authorization is complete, the authorized object obtains access permissions on resources within the specified resource group or Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 调用AttachPolicy为授权对象（RAM用户、RAM用户组或RAM角色）添加权限策略，即授权。完成授权后，被授权对象将获得指定资源组或阿里云账号内资源的访问权限
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager attach-policy --resource-group-id rg-9gLOoK0000 --policy-type System --policy-name AdministratorAccess --principal-type IMSUser --principal-name alice@demo.onaliyun.com --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The authorization scope. Valid values:

Resource group ID: The permissions take effect within the specified resource group.
Alibaba Cloud account ID: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the principal belongs. The permissions take effect within the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
授权范围。取值：

资源组ID：权限在指定的资源组内生效。
阿里云账号ID：被授权对象所属的阿里云账号ID，权限在该阿里云账号内生效
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access policy. Valid values:

Custom: custom access policy.
System: system access policy
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略类型。取值：

Custom：自定义权限策略。
System：系统权限策略
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
Policy Name of the access policy.

Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The authorization object type. Valid values:

IMSUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
IMSGroup: RAM user group.
ServiceRole: RAM role
parameters.help_zh:
被授权对象类型。取值：

IMSUser：RAM用户。
IMSGroup：RAM用户组。
ServiceRole：RAM角色
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the authorization object. The format varies based on the object type:

Resource Access Management (RAM) user: <UserName>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com, where <UserName> is the RAM username and <AccountAlias> is the account alias.
RAM user group: <GroupName>@group.<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com, where <GroupName> is the RAM user group name and <AccountAlias> is the account alias.
RAM role: <RoleName>@role.<AccountAlias>.onaliyunservice.com, where <RoleName> is the RAM role name and <AccountAlias> is the account alias.

The account alias is part of the default domain name. Invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186720.html to obtain the account alias
parameters.help_zh:
被授权对象的名称。具体如下：

RAM用户：格式为<UserName>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com，其中<UserName>为RAM用户名称，<AccountAlias>为账号别名。
RAM用户组：格式为<GroupName>@group.<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com，其中<GroupName>为RAM用户组名称，<AccountAlias>为账号别名。
RAM角色：格式为<RoleName>@role.<AccountAlias>.onaliyunservice.com，其中<RoleName>为RAM角色名称，<AccountAlias>为账号别名。

账号别名是默认域名中的一部分，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186720.html获取账号别名
parameters.name: principal_name
